package bad

import "path/filepath"

// Negative example for TestNoRawGlobInProduction: every call below must be
// flagged. (Stored as .go.txt so the go tool never compiles it.)

func direct(dir string) []string {
	m, _ := filepath.Glob(dir + "/*.crt") // unreadable dir reads as "no certs"
	return m
}

func helper() []string {
	m, _ := glob("/etc/sudoers.d/*") // the collectors' raw helper, same hole
	return m
}

func globChecked(string) {} // a *Checked call is fine and must NOT be flagged

func ok() { globChecked("/boot/vmlinuz-*") }
